name: Film Noir
traits: Venetian-blind stripes and hard pools of light
Editorial crime-file typography and precise red evidence marks

name: Islamic Geometric
traits: Ink, lapis, turquoise, and warm parchment
Symmetry and repetition used as structural rhythm

name: Bauhaus
traits: Form follows function; geometric primitives (circle, square, triangle)

name: Swiss / International Typographic Style
traits: Mathematical grid systems and rigorous alignment

name: De Stijl / Neoplasticism
traits: Only horizontals and verticals; thick black rules

name: Constructivism
traits: Red, black, cream; heavy sans/slab type

name: Suprematism
traits: Pure geometric abstraction floating in space
Limited palette, often on white ground

name: Art Nouveau
traits: Floral and botanical ornament, flowing hair

name: Memphis Design
traits: Playful clashing colors and bold geometric shapes

name: Pop Art
traits: Bright saturated primary colors, bold outlines

name: Op Art
traits: Illusions of motion, depth, and warping

name: Futurism (Italian)
traits: Diagonal, chaotic type on the page

name: Mid-Century Modern
traits: Warm retro palette (mustard, teal, orange, brown)

name: Streamline Moderne
traits: Aerodynamic curves and horizontal speed lines

name: Vienna Secession
traits: Geometric grids of squares married to ornament
Bridge between Art Nouveau and Deco

name: Ukiyo-e
traits: Flat areas of color with bold outlines
Nature, waves, Mt Fuji, everyday life

name: Illuminated Manuscript
traits: Ornate drop caps and gold-leaf illumination
Rich reds, blues, gold on vellum

font.sans: 'Century Old Style', Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', serif

name: Egyptian / Ancient Revival
traits: Hieroglyph and papyrus motifs, lotus, scarab

name: Sumi-e (Japanese Ink Wash)
traits: Monochrome black ink gradients (bokashi) on cream rice-paper backgrounds
Visible brush-stroke texture and ink-bleed edges
Deliberate negative space (ma) as a compositional element
Asymmetric, organic compositions with a single red seal (hanko) accent

font.sans: 'Shippori Mincho', 'Noto Serif JP', 'Zen Old Mincho', serif

name: Fauvism
traits: Wild, non-naturalistic, highly saturated clashing color
Bold flat unmixed color fields applied straight from the tube
Expressive, loose, brush-like edges and borders
High-energy arbitrary palette: hot orange, cobalt, viridian, magenta

name: Cubism
traits: Fragmented, overlapping geometric planes viewed from multiple simultaneous perspectives
Muted earthy ground (ochre, umber, black) punctuated by bolder collage color (sienna, blue)
Thin black contour lines separating each plane, planes overlapping at odd angles

name: Populuxe
traits: Two-tone pastel blocking (turquoise/pink/coral/mint) on warm cream, trimmed in chrome silver
Atomic starburst and boomerang accent shapes used sparingly as optimistic punctuation
Bold italic wedge-shaped display type evoking tailfins and forward motion

font.sans: Futura, Century Gothic, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif

name: Kintsugi
traits: Dark matte ceramic/glaze surfaces (charcoal, near-black) as the base material
Luminous gold seam lines marking every join, division, or repair — imperfection as a visible feature
Warm charcoal-and-gold palette only, with slightly irregular hand-drawn seam paths

font.sans: Noto Serif JP, Shippori Mincho, Georgia, serif
font.display: Shippori Mincho, Noto Serif JP, serif

name: Neoclassicism
traits: Column/pediment motifs used as structural framing, not decoration
Cream/marble-white surfaces with muted gold and deep ink accents; serif type evoking carved stone

name: Pre-Raphaelite
traits: Deep saturated jewel-tone palette (emerald, crimson, gold), built up like glazed paint
Dense, specific botanical motifs framing content, not repeating as flat pattern
Flowing organic linework (hair, vines, drapery) softening hard edges; medieval-romantic, painterly mood

name: Byzantine Mosaic
traits: Gold-ground tesserae backgrounds with luminous, shimmering fields
Jewel-toned glass tile colors: deep sapphire, emerald, ruby
Rigid, frontal, hieratic figures with almond eyes
Geometric tessellated borders framing every panel

name: Chalkboard Lettering
traits: Matte near-black or slate backgrounds with textured chalk-dust strokes
Playful hand-drawn display lettering with varied stroke weight
Doodled flourishes, underlines, and borders framing text
Slightly uneven, hand-drawn edges on every shape

extra.chalk-texture: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 0 1px, transparent 1px), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px)

name: Daguerreotype
traits: Silvery monochrome tonal range with warm sepia-silver undertone
Soft vignette falloff darkening toward the edges
Oval or gilt-edge framing motifs around portraits and cards
Quiet, formal stillness — no grain, scratches, or VHS/CRT artifacts

name: Folk Art / Naive Art
traits: Flattened perspective with no attempt at photographic realism
Decorative repeating motifs: flowers, animals, everyday scenes
Thick, confident hand-drawn outlines and warm handmade charm

name: Persian Miniature
traits: Dense, intricate detail across flattened, multi-perspective compositions
Jewel-toned mineral pigments: lapis blue, vermillion, gold leaf
Ornamental floral (islimi) borders framing every panel
Fine, precise linework and delicate figure rendering
